name: panda-lift-latency-v1.1
revision_note: v1 aborted during the first collection episode metadata serialization (cube.size is a list). No dataset, trained checkpoint, or test result existed; v1.1 fixes only this serialization and preserves the same planned experiment.
task: robosuite 1.5.2 Lift with Panda and default OSC_POSE controller
observation: 49-dimensional state vector; no images, task phase or timer
action: learn XYZ in [-0.5,0.5] and binary gripper; rotational delta fixed zero
termination: stop after eight consecutive official-success steps or 200 controls
primary_metric: official success ever observed at a control boundary within the horizon
secondary_metric: eight consecutive successful control boundaries (0.4 seconds)
primary_comparison: delay50_ema minus delay50 official success, paired model/scenario
causal_scope: same learned checkpoints across execution interventions; no claim that a positive result will transfer from the custom task
limitations: A standard task implemented by an external library, not independent external replication
200-control horizon, early hold stop, no image input, restricted learned rotation; not a leaderboard-equivalent protocol
Training seeds vary initialization and shuffling, not the fixed 128-episode expert dataset
EMA coefficient 0.5 transferred unchanged from the custom task; no Panda test tuning
Only one official manipulation task and five training seeds; no real-robot or safety claim
Robosuite warnings about optional GR1 IK/extra robot models are not needed by Panda OSC_POSE
